    "@type": "Answer",
    "text": "Khelo24match is an online platform with different digital entertainment options. It

    Each of these services has its own page on the website. That is why it will not be difficult to
    get general information."
    }
    },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "How Do We Access the Khelo24match Login Page?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
    "@type": "Answer",
    "text": "An existing account requires a registered username and password. The login
    option is available on the main website.
    Here are the steps to follow:
    Open the Khelo24match official website.
    Find and select the login option.
    Enter the registered username.
    Type the account password.
    Submit the details to open the account.
    However, there is one important point to note. The passwords are case sensitive; therefore,
    be sure that you input the correct letters. Otherwise, you can get your account disabled after
    three wrong attempts."
    }
    },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "What Should We Do If We Forget Our Account Password?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
    "@type": "Answer",
    "text": "Forgetting a password happens from time to time. The login page has a recovery
    option for such cases.
    Click on Forgot Password and input the information that you are asked for. This could be
    your username, email, or even a registered phone number.
    Then, follow the steps provided to you by the system via the registered contact method. An
    OTP could be required to generate a password."
    }
    },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "How Does the Khelo24match Withdrawal Process Work?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
    "@type": "Answer",
    "text": "The withdrawal section is available through the member account. After login,
    open this section to start a request.
    The process usually follows these steps:
    Access the registered account.
    Open the Withdraw section.
    Enter the required bank details.
    Fill in the requested information.
    Review the details and submit the request.
    As per the website, the minimum amount of withdrawal through the internet is INR 100. The
    processing time is approximately one to fifteen minutes. The delay in processing may arise
    for various reasons."
    }
    },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "What Types of Khelo24match Games Are Available?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
    "@type": "Answer",
    "text": "Several entertainment categories appear in the website menu. The listed options
    include Andar Bahar, Teen Patti, Roulette, Dragon Tiger, and Poker.
    Some sections also feature titles from different providers. Aviator is another listed option.
    Each title follows its format and rules.
    The available collection might change with website updates. Check the Games section for
    the current selection before choosing an option."
    }
    },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "How Do We Find Current Khelo24match Offers?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
    "@type": "Answer",
    "text": "Details about member promotions appear in the Promotions section. Visitors can
    open it through the main website menu.
    Registered members should also check their account for active offers. Promotion history
    helps identify the details of an available reward.
    Before making any claim, ensure you understand all of the conditions. Look at the validity
    period, eligibility conditions, and other conditions for each promotional offer."
    }
    },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "What Is the Khelo24match Affiliate Program?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
    "@type": "Answer",
    "text": "The Khelo24match Affiliate program has a separate section for partnership
    details. Interested visitors can visit this page to understand the available referral options.
    The affiliate link is available on the website menu. Click on it to view the details of the
    published program.
    Check the conditions of partnership, eligibility criteria, and reward criteria before becoming a
    part of this process. Any further questions should be directed to the customer care
    department."
    }
    },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "Is There a Mobile Version of the Khelo24match Website?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
    "@type": "Answer",
    "text": "Yes, members can access the website through mobile phones and tablets. A
    compatible browser is enough to open the mobile version.
    An app download option also appears on the website. The listed device options include
    iPhone, iPad, and Android.
    Before running an application, be sure to know the source of the program. The steps should
    be followed as instructed on the official website."
    }
    },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "How Do We Contact Khelo24match Customer Support?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
    "@type": "Answer",
    "text": "Account access, payment queries, and technical problems sometimes need
    direct assistance. Khelo24match customer support handles these types of requests.
    The website publishes the following contact details:
    Customer care: 1800 103 4212
    When sending a request, explain the problem in a few clear sentences. Include the account
    username when needed. In case of technical difficulties, provide information about the part
    and time needed for that. Always refrain from giving the account password and OTP."
    }
    },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "What Safety Rules Should Members Follow While Using Khelo24match?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
    "@type": "Answer",
    "text": "Account security begins with some simple practices. First, there is a minimum
    age of 18 years. Second, it is recommended that each individual maintain only one account.
    Members should follow these safety steps:
    Choose a strong password.
    Keep login details private.
    Log out from shared devices.
    Prevent minors from accessing account details.
    Set personal time and spending limits.
    Contact support if unusual account activity appears.
    Self-exclusion is another option for members who need a longer break. The responsible use
    policy lists periods from six months to five years. Requests must go through customer
    support. During the selected period, members must follow the exclusion rules."
    }
    }]
    }

    return re.test(email);

       if(phone == ''){
       $('.phoneError').css('display','block');
       $('.sendOtpBtn').html('Send OTP').removeAttr('disabled');

            {
              $('.sendOtpBtn').html('Send OTP').removeAttr('disabled');

                $('.mobile_otp_div').show();
                $('.login_form_div, .horizontal_or, .social_login_div, .mobile_number_div ').hide();

                $('.resend_otp_btn').hide()
                $('.login_otp_counter').parent().show()

                  clearInterval(intervalId);
                }

                intervalId =setInterval(function(){
                              timer = timer-1;

                                $('.login_otp_counter').html(timer)
                              }
                              else {
                                $('.resend_otp_btn').show()
                                $('.login_otp_counter').parent().hide()
                              }
                            },1000)
              }else{
                $('.sendOtpBtn').removeAttr('disabled');
                notify(data.message)
              }
            }
          });

       }

<script>
data_src()
function data_src(){
    const images = document.querySelectorAll('.js-lazy-image');
    const config = {
        rootMargin: '50px 0px',
        threshold: 0.01
    };

    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        var observer = new IntersectionObserver(onIntersection, config);
        images.forEach(image => {
            observer.observe(image);
        });
    }

    function onIntersection(entries) {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
            if (entry.intersectionRatio > 0) {
                observer.unobserve(entry.target);
                loadImage(entry.target);
            }
        });
    }

    function loadImage(img) {
        // img.src = img.dataset.src;
        // img.classList.add('imageloaded');
        // img.onerror = function() {
        //     img.onerror = null;
        //     img.src = img.dataset.placeholder;
        //     img.style.backgroundImage = 'url(' + img.dataset.placeholder + ')';
        // };
        img.onerror = function() {
        img.onerror = null;
        // Handle only the specific Top Casino Types section
        if (img.classList.contains('js-hide-on-error')) {
            const categoryDiv = img.closest('.top_game_clmn, li');
            if (categoryDiv) {
                categoryDiv.style.display = 'none';
            }
            return;
        }

// OTP FUNCTIONALITY FOR ALL OTP MODULE

const otpInputs = document.querySelectorAll(".verification-code--inputs input");
let isPasting = false;
let hadValueOnBackspace = false;
otpInputs.forEach(input => {
  input.addEventListener("paste", function (ev) {
    ev.preventDefault();
    const clipboardData = ev.clipboardData || ev.originalEvent.clipboardData;
    const text = clipboardData.getData("text").trim();
    const container = this.closest('.verification-code--inputs');
    const inputs = container.querySelectorAll('input');
    if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(text)) {
      notify("Invalid OTP: Please enter exactly 6 numeric digits", "danger");
      return;
    }
    const chars = [...text];
    isPasting = true;
    inputs.forEach((inp, index) => {
      inp.value = chars[index];
      inp.classList.add('focus');
    });
    checkIfAllInputsFilled(inputs);
    inputs.forEach(inp => inp.blur());
  });
  input.addEventListener("keydown", function (ev) {
    const allowedKeys = ["Backspace", "ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "Tab", "Delete"];
    const isCtrlCombo = ev.ctrlKey || ev.metaKey;
    const isDigit = /^\d$/.test(ev.key);
    if (!isDigit && !allowedKeys.includes(ev.key) && !isCtrlCombo && ev.key !== "Unidentified") {
      ev.preventDefault();
    }
    if (ev.key === "Backspace") {
      hadValueOnBackspace = this.value !== '';
    }
  });
  input.addEventListener("keyup", function (ev) {
    if (isPasting) {
      isPasting = false;
      return;
    }
    const container = this.closest('.verification-code--inputs');
    const otpWrapper = this.closest('.otp_field_wrapper');
    const verifyButton = otpWrapper.querySelector(".verifyOtpBtn,.verifyOtpFp,.submitRegOtpMain,.otpVerifyBtn");
    const inputs = container.querySelectorAll('input');
    const index = Array.from(inputs).indexOf(this);
    if (ev.key === "Backspace") {
      this.value = '';
      this.classList.remove('focus');
      checkIfAllInputsFilled(inputs);
      if (!hadValueOnBackspace && index > 0) {
        inputs[index - 1].focus();
      }
      return;
    }
    if (ev.key === "ArrowLeft") {
      if (this.value !== '' && index > 0) {
        inputs[index - 1].focus();
      }
      return;
    }

    if (ev.key === "ArrowRight") {
      if (this.value !== '' && index < inputs.length - 1) {
        inputs[index + 1].focus();
      }
      return;
    }

    if (/^\d$/.test(ev.key)) {
      this.value = ev.key;
      this.classList.add('focus');
      // 👇 Always move to next field regardless of its value
      if (index < inputs.length - 1) {
        inputs[index + 1].focus();
      } else if (index === inputs.length - 1 && this.value !== '') {
        this.blur();
      }
      checkIfAllInputsFilled(inputs);
    }else if (ev.key !== 'Tab') {
          this.value = '';
          this.classList.remove('focus');
    }
  });
  input.addEventListener("input", function () {
    if (isPasting) return;
    const container = this.closest('.verification-code--inputs');
    const inputs = container.querySelectorAll('input');
    const value = this.value;
    if (value.length > 1) {
      const chars = [...value];
      inputs.forEach((inp, idx) => {
        inp.value = chars[idx] || '';
        if (chars[idx]) inp.classList.add('focus');
      });
      checkIfAllInputsFilled(inputs);
      inputs.forEach(inp => inp.blur());
    } else {
      this.value = value.slice(-1);
    }
  });
  input.addEventListener("focus", function () {
    this.classList.add('focus');
  });

  input.addEventListener("blur", function () {
    this.value = this.value.slice(0, 1);
    if (!this.value) {
      this.classList.remove('focus');
    }
  });
});

function checkIfAllInputsFilled(inputs) {
  const allFilled = Array.from(inputs).every(input => /^\d$/.test(input.value));
  const wrapper = inputs[0].closest('.otp_field_wrapper');
  const verifyButton = wrapper.querySelector(".verifyOtpBtn,.verifyOtpFp,.submitRegOtpMain,.otpVerifyBtn");
  if (verifyButton) {
    verifyButton.disabled = !allFilled;
  }
}

    function getBalance() {
        $('.wallet_balance').html('Loading...').addClass('loadBal')
		$('.totalExposure').html('Loading...').addClass('loadBal')
		$('.bonus_balance').html('Loading...').addClass('loadBal')

        $('.refresh_balance').find('.fa-refresh').addClass('fa-spin')

        $.ajax({
            url: '/api/getBalance',
            type: 'get',
            async: 'false',
            success: function(response) {
                $('.wallet_balance').attr('data-actual', response.balance.balance.replace(',', ''));

                $('.wallet_balance').attr('data-wager', response.balance.wager_formatted);

                $('.wallet_balance').attr('data-mode', response.balance.wager==response.balance.totalCasinoBalance?'casino':'slots');

                $('.mainBalance').text(response.balance.totalBalance);
                $('.promotionBalance').text(response.balance.wager_formatted);

                $('.real_chips').text('(₹'+response.balance.totalBalance+')');
                $('.bonus_chips').text('(₹'+response.balance.wager_formatted+')');
                $('.wager_taget_').text('₹'+response.balance.wager_taget_formatted);

                setTimeout(function () {
                  $('.refresh_balance').find('.fa-refresh').removeClass('fa-spin');

                },1000)

                if (response.lowBalance != 'hide') {
                  if (response.balance.main_balance.replace(/,/g, '') < 1000) {
                    $('.low-balance-holder').parent().show()
                  }
                  else {
                    $('.low-balance-holder').parent().hide()
                  }
                }

                if (response.balance.main_balance.replace(/,/g, '') > 0) {
                  $('.wallet_balance').parents('li').removeClass('lowBalance').addClass('Balance')
                }
                else {
                  $('.wallet_balance').parents('li').removeClass('Balance').addClass('lowBalance')
                }

                $('.wallet_balance').html(response.balance.main_balance.replace(/,/g, '') > 0 ? response.balance.main_balance : '0.00')

                $('.bonus_balance').html(response.balance.wager_formatted.replace(/,/g, '') > 0 ? response.balance.wager_formatted : '0.00')

                $('.totalExposure').html(response.balance.exposure)

                $('.loyalty_points').html(~~response.balance.loyalty)

                var t = parseFloat(response.balance.totalBalance.replace(/,/g, '')) + parseFloat(response.balance.wager_formatted.replace(/,/g, ''));

                $('.detail_balance').html(t > 0 ? t.toFixed(2) : '0.00');
                $('.detail_cash_percentage').html('( ' + response.balance.next_split_cash + '% )');
                $('.detail_cash').html(response.balance.balance);

                $('.detail_wager_target').html(response.balance.wager_taget_formatted);
